semiconductor_relevance: High — Joinpath Materials Technology specializes in high-purity fluid delivery equipment and specialty gases essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Joinpath Materials Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd focuses on providing high-purity fluid delivery systems and specialty gases for the semiconductor industry. With over 20 years of experience, the company delivers innovative solutions that meet the stringent quality and safety standards required by electronics customers globally.
capabilities: ALD & CVD precursors canister systems for continuous precursor supply
Compressed and liquified gas delivery systems
Dual cylinder design for continuous gas supply
Specialty gas mixtures including HF, HBr, and SiH4

regional_presence.Korea: Joinpath operates in Korea, providing high-end products and services to local semiconductor manufacturers.
regional_presence.Mainland China: The company is based in Shanghai and serves the Chinese semiconductor market extensively.
regional_presence.Singapore: Joinpath has a presence in Singapore, catering to the electronics sector.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company also operates in Taiwan, supporting semiconductor fabrication and related industries.
